headline: Barry end Florida Southern's unbeaten conference run
dek: Barry handed Florida Southern only their second defeat of the season. It leaves them level on points with Embry-Riddle, who were held by Lynn the same night, behind Florida Tech, who host Florida Southern on Wednesday in the last match either side has scheduled.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Every side in the conference has now lost a conference match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result; Palm Beach Atlantic are party to all of them but Eckerd's and Saint Leo's home matches against Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored seventeen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 27 goals this season, from 60 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored fifteen of Rollins' 25 goals this season, from 61 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 34 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Barry have won every match since losing at Florida Tech; Florida Southern had not lost in conference play until now.

next_match.line: Florida Tech's only conference defeat came against Embry-Riddle; Florida Southern have not won since beating Palm Beach Atlantic.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
